Name: ModernConfigMenu
Author: palmhacker13
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Modern Config Menu[/b][/size]
A beautiful, highly reactive visual overhaul and extension for [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]
[size=2]Current Version: [b]1.7.7[/b][/size][/center]

[center]————————————————————————————[/center]

Transforms the standard Stardew Valley config UI into a sleek, modern, and animated interface — [b]without breaking your existing mods.[/b]

[size=4][b]🎨 Why Use Modern Config Menu?[/b][/size]
If you have GMCM installed, Modern Config Menu will [b]automatically intercept all registered mods[/b] and display them in a premium, modern dashboard. You get the best of both worlds: GMCM's massive mod compatibility, paired with a gorgeous, smooth, fully-featured interface!
[line]

[size=4][b]🚀 Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]✨ Gorgeous UI Skin for GMCM[/b] — Automatically imports and styles all your GMCM configurations with a clean layout, modern fonts, and smooth animations. No changes needed from other mod authors.[/*]
[*][b]🎛️ Premium Interactive Widgets[/b] — Upgrades standard options into beautiful [b]Toggles[/b], [b]Sliders[/b], [b]Dropdowns[/b], [b]Textboxes[/b], [b]Keybinds[/b], and [b]Buttons[/b].[/*]
[*][b]⚡ Live-Apply Settings[/b] — See changes instantly in-game as you drag sliders or flip toggles (on compatible settings).[/*]
[*][b]🎨 Customizable Themes[/b] — Choose between Dark, Light, and curated color palettes directly inside the settings.[/*]
[*][b]⭐ Mod Favorites System[/b] — Star your most-used mods and filter them instantly with the "⭐ Favorites" category. Saved persistently.[/*]
[*][b]🏷️ Custom Category Tagging[/b] — Assign custom tags (e.g. QoL, Visuals, Cheats, Gameplay) to any mod's config page, dynamically integrated into the Category Dropdown.[/*]
[*][b]🔍 Triple-Filter Search Engine[/b] — Simultaneously filter by [b]Category[/b], [b]Favorites[/b], and [b]Search Query[/b] in real time.[/*]
[*][b]🌐 14-Language i18n Support[/b] — Full localization for EN, TH, ZH, JA, KO, DE, ES, FR, IT, PT, RU, HU, TR, UK — with a custom TTF font engine for crisp non-Latin glyphs (Thai, CJK, Cyrillic).[/*]
[*][b]🛡️ Smart Hotkey Conflict Detection[/b] — Automatically detects hotkey collisions with other mods and logs SMAPI warnings. Emergency fallback: [b]Shift + F8[/b] always works.[/*]
[*][b]🖥️ 4K / High-DPI / Ultrawide Support[/b] — Fully responsive layout with dynamic scale-capping. Prevents UI from ever expanding off-screen. Auto-adjusts on window resize.[/*]
[*][b]📱 Responsive Single-Column Layout[/b] — Automatically collapses to single-column on small resolutions, windowed mode, or high UI scale levels.[/*]
[*][b]🛠️ System Diagnostics Tool[/b] — Built-in button to analyze real-time CPU, GPU, and RAM usage directly into the SMAPI console log.[/*]
[*][b]🎮 Controller & Keyboard Friendly[/b] — Full controller navigation, [b]Ctrl+F[/b] for instant search focus, and smart [b]Esc[/b] handling.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]🛠️ Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url] (v4.0.0 or newer) — [b]Required[/b][/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url] — [b]Required[/b] for loading other mods' settings[/*]
[*]Download [b]Modern Config Menu[/b] and extract it into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game — the menu opens via hotkey![/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]💻 For Mod Authors (Optional Native Integration)[/b][/size]

You do [b]not[/b] need to change anything for your mod to look beautiful in Modern Config Menu! All GMCM-registered mods are automatically styled.

However, if you want to use [b]native features[/b] (live-apply, custom categories, real-time validation, sections, labels, etc.), use our public API:

[b]Getting the API[/b]

[code]IModConfigMenuApi? api = helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IModConfigMenuApi>("palmhacker13.ModernConfigMenu");[/code]
[b]Full API Example[/b]

[code]if (api != null)
{
    api.Register(this.ModManifest, () => this.Config = new ModConfig(), () => this.Helper.WriteConfig(this.Config));

    // Optional: assign a category tag for the Category Dropdown
    api.SetModCategory(this.ModManifest, "Visuals");

    // Group settings into named sections
    api.AddSection(this.ModManifest, "Audio");

    // Slider with live-apply and custom format label
    api.Slider(this.ModManifest, () => this.Config.Volume, val => this.Config.Volume = val, 0f, 100f, "Volume")
      .Live()                        // Apply value instantly as the slider drags
      .Format(v => $"{v:0}%");      // Custom display format

    // Toggle with live-apply
    api.Toggle(this.ModManifest, () => this.Config.Enabled, val => this.Config.Enabled = val, "Enabled")
      .Live();

    // Dropdown
    api.Dropdown(this.ModManifest, () => this.Config.Theme, val => this.Config.Theme = val,
        new[] { "Dark", "Light", "Parchment" }, "Theme");

    // Keybind
    api.Keybind(this.ModManifest, () => this.Config.OpenKey, val => this.Config.OpenKey = val, "Open Key");

    // Action button
    api.Button(this.ModManifest, "Open Save Folder", () => OpenSaveFolder(), tooltip: "Opens the save directory in Explorer");

    // Programmatically scroll to this mod and open the menu
    api.OpenMenu(this.ModManifest);
}[/code]

[size=4][b]❓ FAQ[/b][/size]

[b]Q: Do I need to edit my existing GMCM mod to work with this?[/b]
A: No! Modern Config Menu automatically intercepts all GMCM-registered mods. Zero changes needed.

[b]Q: The menu won't open / hotkey conflict![/b]
A: Press [b]Shift + F8[/b] to force-open at any time. Then rebind your hotkey inside the menu settings.

[b]Q: Is it compatible with [some mod]?[/b]
A: If the mod uses GMCM, it's compatible — automatically!

[b]Q: My language isn't showing correctly.[/b]
A: Make sure your in-game language is set. Supported languages: EN, TH, ZH, JA, KO, DE, ES, FR, IT, PT, RU, HU, TR, UK.
